name: Control Browser
description: Manages browser tabs in JARVIS's own Chrome (list, focus, close, close_current, open_url, refresh), and close_browser: closes JARVIS's own Chrome after asking the owner (never the owner's everyday Chrome).

action.description: Browser command: 'list', 'focus', 'close', 'close_current', 'open_url', 'refresh', 'close_browser' (the whole of JARVIS's Chrome; no target)

target.description: Tab title, URL pattern, or target tab search query
